latest_release.body:
## :warning: Security Fixes

This maintenance release fixes the following 13 CVEs:

* [CVE-2026-59374](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59374) "Spring Framework Data Binding vulnerability on indexed data types"
* [CVE-2026-59389](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59389) "Spring Framework multipart part smuggling vulnerability"
* [CVE-2026-59390](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59390) "Spring Framework No Origin Validation If WebSocket Handling Configured Directly"
* [CVE-2026-59391](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59391) "Spring Framework Message Smuggling with External STOMP Broker"
* [CVE-2026-59392](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59392) "Spring Framework STOMP Message Disclosure with SockJS Transport"
* [CVE-2026-59393](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59393) "Spring Framework maxInMemorySize Bypassed in Jaxb2Decoder"
* [CVE-2026-59394](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59394) "Spring Framework Open Redirect in UrlHandlerFilter"
* [CVE-2026-59398](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59398) "Spring Framework Denial of Service with Parameter-based Content Negotiation"
* [CVE-2026-59418](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59418) "Spring Framework Denial of Service with streaming text decoding in WebFlux"
* [CVE-2026-59419](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59419) "Spring Framework Denial of Service with HTTP client observations"
* [CVE-2026-59429](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59429) "Spring Framework Denial of Service via PathPattern"
* [CVE-2026-59430](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59430) "Spring Framework Unintended Constructor and Method Invocation via Type Conversion in SpEL"
* [CVE-2026-59431](https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59431) "Spring Framework Denial of Service via SpEL Collection Selection"

## :star: New Features

- Ignore empty buffers in StompDecoder [#37660](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37660)
- Improve valid URL checks in ResourceHandlerUtils [#37650](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37650)
- Add dedicated `pause` and `restart` callbacks to `SmartLifecycle` [#37630](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37630)
- Fix media type API version fallback to Content-Type [#37620](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/37620)
- Close deferred query sessions after JPA 4.0 getResultCount [#37587](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37587)
- Apply auto-grow collection limit to direct field binding [#36862](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36862)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Incomplete RequestPart argument name resolution in HandlerMethodValidator [#37653](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37653)
- Indexed binding fails for self-populating lists such as `AutoPopulatingList` [#37634](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37634)
- ServerHttpObservationFilter records http.server.requests twice when an async request times out [#37627](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37627)
- Handler methods rediscover parameter names on every invocation, which is costly for Kotlin [#37625](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37625)
- `SimpleAsyncTaskScheduler` does not apply its `TaskDecorator` to fixed-delay tasks [#37612](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37612)
- `@Retryable` and `@ConcurrencyLimit` on an implementation method are not applied with a JDK dynamic proxy [#37611](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37611)
- `SimplePropertyRowMapper` fails for case-insensitive match against read-only property [#37609](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/37609)
- Do not remap constructor properties in `SimplePropertyRowMapper` [#37602](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/37602)
- Propagate Reactor Context for Flux in reactive caching [#37600](https://github.com/spring-projects/s

detail.readme: # Spring Framework [![Build Status](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/actions/workflows/build-and-deploy-snapshot.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/actions/workflows/build-and-deploy-snapshot.yml?query=branch%3Amain) [![Revved up by Develocity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Revved%20up%20by-Develocity-06A0CE?logo=Gradle&labelColor=02303A)](https://ge.spring.io/scans?search.rootProjectNames=spring) This is the home of the Spring Framework: the foundation for all [Spring projects](https://spring.io/projects). Collectively the Spring Framework and the family of Spring projects are often referred to simply as "Spring". Spring provides everything required beyond the Java programming language for creating enterprise applications for a wide range of scenarios and architectures. Please read the [Overview](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/overview.html) section of the reference documentation for a more complete introduction. ## Code of Conduct This project is governed by the [Spring Code of Conduct](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/?tab=coc-ov-file#contributor-code-of-conduct). By participating, you are expected to uphold this code of conduct. Please report unacceptable behavior to spring-code-of-conduct@spring.io. ## Access to Binaries For access to artifacts or a distribution zip, see the [Spring Framework Artifacts](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/wiki/Spring-Framework-Artifacts) wiki page. ## Documentation The Spring Framework maintains reference documentation ([published](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/reference/) and [source](framework-docs/modules/ROOT)), GitHub [wiki pages](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/wiki), and an [API reference](https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/docs/current/javadoc-api/). There are also [guides and tutorials](https://spring.io/guides) across Spring projects. ## Micro-Benchmarks See the [Micro-Benchmarks](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/wiki/Micro-Benchmarks) wiki page. ## Build from Source See the [Build from Source](CONTRIBUTING.md#build-from-source) section of the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) file. ## Continuous Integration Builds CI builds are defined with [GitHub Actions workflows](.github/workflows). ## Stay in Touch Follow [@SpringCentral](https://twitter.com/springcentral), [@SpringFramework](https://twitter.com/springframework), and its [team members](https://twitter.com/springframework/lists/team/members) on 𝕏. In-depth articles can be found at [The Spring Blog](https://spring.io/blog/), and releases are announced via our [releases feed](https://spring.io/blog/category/releases). ## License The Spring Framework is released under version 2.0 of the [Apache License](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
